$comment: Hexium (valheim.hexium.gg) listing settings for the release workflow: the counterpart of thunderstore.toml.
Hexium's upload ignores categories and install location; they're set after upload with
POST /api/mod/{namespace}/{name}/set-metadata, or by hand on the site. Version, description and dependencies
come from the manifest.json in the Release zip, as for Thunderstore.
Every build checks this file (docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, section 6): namespace must equal ThunderstoreTeam, name must
equal AssemblyName, installLocation must be client, server, both or client_opt_server, and categories must be
filled in, never undefined. Category slugs are their display names, e.g. Quality of Life:
Don't list Client-only, Server-only, Client & Server or Client (& Server): Hexium shows those from installLocation.
name: QuanPieces
